criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Greetings and Gratitude
categories.definition: Utterances expressing thanks, greetings, or general social pleasantries towards the bot or assistant.

categories.name: Transmission and Contamination
categories.definition: Questions regarding how the virus spreads, survival on surfaces, or transmission risks from animals, food, and specific activities.

categories.name: Case Statistics and News
categories.definition: Requests for quantitative data on cases, deaths, and recoveries, or general news updates and situation reports.

categories.name: Treatment and Cure
categories.definition: Questions about medical treatments, cures, home remedies, vaccines, or medication for COVID-19.

categories.name: Symptoms and Diagnosis
categories.definition: Questions identifying symptoms of the virus or asking if specific physical sensations indicate an infection.

categories.name: Prevention and Safety Measures
categories.definition: Requests for advice on protective actions, hygiene practices, cleaning protocols, and safety equipment to avoid infection.

categories.name: Travel and Movement Restrictions
categories.definition: Questions about the safety or permissibility of travel, commuting, and movement under current restrictions.

categories.name: General Information and Explanation
categories.definition: Broad requests for information about what the virus is, how it works, or general educational content.

categories.name: Sharing and Functionality
categories.definition: Commands or questions regarding the technical operation of the bot, such as sharing content or links.

categories.name: Donations and Financial Aid
categories.definition: Requests to contribute money or support to relief efforts, charities, or specific groups affected by the pandemic.

categories.name: Myths and Misconceptions
categories.definition: Questions seeking to verify or debunk specific rumors, conspiracy theories, or misinformation about COVID-19.
